evidence_items.explanation: HaluEval directly tests recognition of generated hallucinations: ChatGPT achieved 62.59% accuracy in question answering, rising to 76.83% with retrieved knowledge. These substantial remaining errors support unreliable factual checking; the summarization results are less direct because their labels also concern faithfulness to a source.

This is material counterevidence to complete inability: both models recognized many errors when claims were presented separately. The three constructed tasks and conditional error-detection rates do not establish dependable general checking, so this does not meet the contract's contradiction condition.

evidence_items.explanation: Repeated sampling enabled useful factuality assessment of GPT-3 output without an external database. This qualifies Marcus's wording, but the evaluation covered 238 biographical passages and reported ranking performance, rather than dependable classification across general factual tasks.
